title: Size of debris net openings.
officialText:
Section 6.6 of ANSI/ASSE A10.11 shall be amended by adding a new sentence at
the end of the section, as follows, “However, in no case shall the largest opening area for debris netting when used
horizontally be larger than ½ square inch (12.7 mm2).”
